directions.description: Replace the exact-identity commuting condition with an order-in-h defect measure between M[L_D(F)] and T_D(Phi_h^M[F]), rather than a binary equality that collapses to definitional under candidate (a).
directions.routes_around: Round 3 Balthasar: under candidate (a) the identity is definitional/tautological, D_1!=D_2 inert; flagged in Round 3 unfinished list as untouched asymptotic-in-h refinement.
directions.heuristic: An order-based statement gives real negative control since methods can share leading order but diverge at higher order, unlike an exact identity built from the same candidate it tests.

directions.description: Ground the per-coordinate lift in an explicit universal property relative to the category of Weil algebras and their structure maps, instead of picking a candidate (a)/(b)-style map off a menu and testing it post hoc.
directions.routes_around: Casper Round 3: near-circular product-preserving-functor naturality with no negative control; Round 1/2 pattern of ad hoc candidate selection.
directions.heuristic: A universal-property lift is either uniquely forced or provably nonexistent, both informative, unlike a chosen candidate that may already encode the property being tested for.

directions.description: Split the claim into a scoped sufficiency-only statement for B-series-expressible methods, with the wider class (implicit/root-selecting, adaptive, norm-comparison methods) logged as a separate open question rather than folded into the same necessity test.
directions.routes_around: Round 3 Balthasar: backward Euler is a genuine counterexample to the necessity half of any B-series characterization.
directions.heuristic: Removing necessity from the object of test (rather than patching the definition again) neutralizes the counterexample without another ad hoc lift-tweak.

directions.description: Require naturality across the full diagram of Weil algebras W_D, W_D' related by truncation/refinement maps for varying per-coordinate order vectors, rather than testing commuting at one fixed D.
directions.routes_around: Round 3 Balthasar: single-D identity is definitional and D_1!=D_2 does no work; this makes D-variation load-bearing via an indexed diagram condition instead of a single square.
directions.heuristic: Same naturality/functoriality family but a diagram condition across several D's is not automatically satisfied by construction the way one instance is; untested, so the Round 3 tautology argument does not obviously transfer.

directions.description: Leave the per-coordinate fibered-extension branch entirely and take one of the other four Round-0 candidate directions (parameter/time/initial-value extension, nested/iterated extension, isomorphic-dimension Weil algebras, or vector-field class strengthening) as the next claim.
directions.routes_around: Three consecutive structural failures on the per-coordinate branch (R1 untyped/misframed, R2 vacuous diagnostic, R3 tautological/undefined-off-slice lift); Casper R1 flagged this branch as breaking load-bearing coordinate-freedom.
directions.heuristic: A branch failing structurally three times running is weak evidence the branch itself is the obstruction, not just each statement tried on it; an unrelated Round-0 branch is a cheaper next unit of effort than a fourth per-coordinate attempt.
